summary: Frontend-only testing of CatatAgen Expo web preview at 390x844. Covered Input tab (type tabs, nominal/admin auto-fill for Transfer & Tarik, PPOB flow, save, templates, validation), Riwayat (filters w/ counts, date grouping, tx-delete + confirm sheet), Rekap (modes, prev/next, totals, per-type breakdown), Admin (ranges CRUD + save + add + default), Backup (copy, restore merge w/ valid JSON, invalid JSON rejected), and persistence after reload. All 13 features from the request passed.

issues: Console warns: 'shadow*' style props deprecated, should migrate to 'boxShadow' (RN Web). Non-blocking.

action_items: Optional: replace deprecated shadow* style props with boxShadow to silence RN Web console warnings.

Offline-only app: no backend calls detected; storage via AsyncStorage/localStorage persists on reload.
